title: The Hayley Williams Show 2026: Here’s Where to Shop Affordable Concert Tickets Online
summary: The pop rock singer/songwriter continues her tour across the United States.
contentText:
All products and services featured are independently chosen by editors. However, Billboard may receive a commission on orders placed through its retail links, and the retailer may receive certain auditable data for accounting purposes.

Paramore frontwoman Hayley Williams is now on tour with The Hayley Williams Show throughout the United States, with dates in New York City, Cincinnati, New Orleans, Los Angeles and other cities. The U.S. leg ends at BankPlus Amphitheater at Snowden Grove in Southaven, Mississippi, on Monday, Oct. 12.

Meanwhile, the tour is in support of her latest album, Ego Death at a Bachelorette Party , which was released in August 2025. Additionally, there’s a small lineup of recording artists who are set to support, including Magdalena Bay and Rico Nasty.

Shop Hayley Williams Tour Tickets at Ticketmaster

Tickets to the tour first went on sale through Live Nation and Ticketmaster , while the retailer’s Face Value Exchange program is an option for fans to resell tickets.

However, many of the dates have either sold out, or are very close to selling out, so one of the best ways to find last-minute Hayley Williams tickets online is through third-party sites, such as StubHub , Vivid Seats , SeatGeek , TicketNetwork , Gametime , Event Tickets Center and others. All online retailers guarantee authentic tickets in time for your concert. Prices may be above or below face value at times.

Where to Find Hayley Williams Show 2026 Tickets Online

EDITOR'S PICK

Find Hayley Williams Tickets at StubHub

find tickets at StubHub

Top choice for concert tickets in 2026.

StubHub has all-in pricing, so all fees are listed upfront. The site’s “FanProtect Guarantee” ensures that tickets are valid and delivered in time for the concert. If not, you’ll get your money back. Additionally, if the concert is canceled and not rescheduled, you’ll receive 120% credit, or be offered a full refund without the extra credit. At the time of publishing, Hayley Williams tickets start at $39.

Find Hayley Williams Tickets at Vivid Seats

FIND TICKETS at Vivid Seats

Vivid Seats lets you search by type of seat, such as suite, standing room, front of section or the VIP section, while the retailer prioritizes “Super Sellers” who are “experienced, highly-rated sellers.” With Vivid Seats, your purchase is protected with the company’s “100% Buyer Guarantee,” which ensures that you receive legitimate tickets in time for your concert, or your money back.

Find Hayley Williams Tickets at SeatGeek

FIND TICKETS at SeatGeek

Tickets are delivered digitally via email, so they’re available on your phone before you go through security. And prices are surprisingly reasonable, even for the hottest tickets. For example, SeatGeek has cheap Hayley Williams tickets online from $25. Use our discount code BILLBOARD10 to save an additional $10 at checkout.

PROMO CODE

Find Hayley Williams Tickets at TicketNetwork

find tickets at TicketNetwork

Don’t forget TicketNetwork . The retailer has ticket packages, which include parking passes, VIP access, meet and greets and other great experiences. It has tickets to Hayley Williams’ concerts with all-in pricing that lets you see exactly what you’ll pay up front (fees included). Tickets start at $30, as of this writing. You can use our exclusive code BILLBOARD150 to save $150 off purchases over $500, or BILLBOARD300 to save $300 off orders of $1000 and up.

And since TicketNetwork is a resale site, the company says that pricing may sometimes be below face value because tickets aren’t held to a specific price point. It guarantees that the tickets you receive are the ones you purchased, and sometimes, even better than expected.

SEATING OPTIONS

Find Hayley Williams Tickets at Gametime

find tickets at Gametime

Gametime is a stellar third-party retailer for fans looking for affordable tickets. Tickets for in-demand concerts like Hayley Williams start at $23. It guarantees the lowest prices, event cancellation protection and on-time ticket delivery for a smooth ticket buying experience.
